# Hostname

Get or set the hostname of target hosts.
`osapi dsl behavior get --name hostname` and `osapi dsl behavior method get`
show the same.

## Method update

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | update                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Description | Set the hostname of the host                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Detail      | Sets the static hostname with hostnamectl set-hostname, which keeps it after a reboot. A host that already has the name does not change and reports changed: false. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped. In a container the runtime owns the hostname, so there it also reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | PUT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/hostname                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Permission  | hostname:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Command     | [osapi client node hostname update](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/hostname/update.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Input type  | UpdateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                     | DESCRIPTION                         |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| name  | string | yes      | format hostname, max length 253 | The hostname to set, such as web-01 |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The hostname of the host |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                          | INPUT       | OUTPUT                     |
| -------------------------------- | ----------- | -------------------------- |
| Rename a host                    | name=web-02 | name=web-02, changed=true  |
| A host that already has the name | name=web-01 | name=web-01, changed=false |
